text: Claims for advanced imaging (MRI, CT, PET) require prior authorization on file before the date of service. Claims submitted without an approved PA number will be denied.
appeal_hint: Submit the prior authorization approval number if one was obtained retroactively, or request a peer-to-peer review with the ordering physician to establish medical necessity.

text: Services must be supported by documentation establishing medical necessity per current clinical guidelines. Claims lacking sufficient clinical documentation linking diagnosis to treatment will be denied.
appeal_hint: Resubmit with additional clinical notes, lab results, or specialist referral letters that directly tie the diagnosis to the treatment rendered.

text: Claims must be submitted within 90 days of the date of service. Claims submitted after this window will be denied for untimely filing, absent a documented exception.
appeal_hint: If there was a documented delay (e.g., coordination of benefits, late notification of coverage), submit proof of the delay along with a timely filing exception request.

text: Services rendered by out-of-network providers are not covered except in documented emergency circumstances or when no in-network provider was available within a reasonable distance.
appeal_hint: Provide documentation showing the emergency nature of the visit or that no in-network provider was accessible within the plan's required distance/time standard.

text: A claim for the same service, same provider, and same date of service has already been processed and paid or is pending. Duplicate submissions will be denied.
appeal_hint: Verify the original claim number and confirm this submission includes a corrected claim indicator if it is meant to replace, not duplicate, the prior submission.

text: The submitted procedure code is considered bundled into a more comprehensive code billed on the same date of service, per standard coding edits (e.g., NCCI). Separate reimbursement is not allowed.
appeal_hint: Review whether a modifier (e.g., -59) applies to indicate the service was distinct and separately identifiable, and resubmit with supporting documentation.

text: Patient was not enrolled in an active plan on the date of service, based on eligibility records at time of adjudication.
appeal_hint: Submit proof of active coverage on the date of service (enrollment confirmation, premium payment record) as eligibility records may lag actual enrollment status.

text: Plan requires documented trial and failure of a first-line, lower-cost alternative medication before the requested medication will be covered.
appeal_hint: Submit documentation of prior medication trials, including dates, dosages, and clinical reason for discontinuation (e.g., adverse reaction, lack of efficacy).
